research_question: Does a common AI preserve source-specific public sector judgments in justified equity-sector allocations, and how does early versus late evidence provision change that reflection?
research_claim_scope: Descriptive public-document case under one shared model; evidence-to-rationale-to-allocation preservation, conditional on the task and runtime.

period.claim: retrospective document-conditioned case, not point-in-time trading replay

inputs: common market evidence in the same sector taxonomy
dated institution documents containing relevant objectives, applicable constraints or sector judgments
main.document_roles: Legal investment mandates, fund-manager commentary and house research views are distinct evidence types. A house outlook is not silently assigned to an unrelated fund as its mandate.
main.risk_policy: Preserve qualitative preferences; retain only explicitly supported numerical limits, denominators and exceptions. Do not map real-fund prose to gamma.
model_decisions: propose sector weights and explain the evidence supporting departures from a common baseline when one is specified
main.gold_visibility: Evaluator-only inventory and blank worksheets prepared; independent human review pending.
main.calculation: Existing pure calculator retained conceptually; v4.8 empty-optional-proposal and fact-ID integration pending.
main.calculator_information_boundary: Tools may use only evidence already exposed in that run and model-submitted inputs. Before R4 receives its institution packet, tools cannot read hidden mandates, evaluator annotations or institution-specific constraints. Missing constraints remain unknown; no automatic gold-based repair, lookup or informative feasibility response is allowed.
main.no_synthetic_real_facts: Do not invent institutional expected returns, confidence, sector caps or exact target weights from qualitative prose.
pending: Integrate v4.8 contracts and registry with runner/scorer
Run and review all four v4.8 pilot cases
Freeze before main; main not executed here
main.representation: Researcher-selected short paraphrased evidence, original labels, source IDs and page locators; not full-document retrieval.
main.baseline: Reported 2026-06-30 S&P500 sector weights, sum99.9%, original preserved and normalized for common arithmetic; not institution holdings/targets
main.runtime_policy: No v4.8 online execution or main freeze yet.

stages: provisional sector allocation with all 11 sectors
workflow.interpretation: Evidence-onset and subsequent-use workflow policy, including position and context age; not an isolated memory mechanism.
workflow.retrieval: Directly supplied evidence first; actual retrieval quality remains a separate extension, not an executed RAG result.
workflow.inference: descriptive case study; two source documents, not powered population experiment
workflow.history_semantics: visible model responses and calculator feedback retained; not hidden thinking traces

model.settings_observation_scope: Engine settings observed in historical v4.5 only. No v4.8 request has run.
model.runtime_readiness_policy: Installation or pilot status is reported separately; this builder never certifies execution readiness.

model_basis.scope: exact base model evaluated in finance; target decoding not fully disclosed
base Qwen3.5-4B; explicit JSON and disabled thinking; not the LoRA adapter

parameter_basis.note: Ollama implementation candidate; also T=0 in PortBench; not identical engine reproduction
Not FinVector's 700-token condition; adequacy checked on pilot, before main
Preserve all four stages including visible responses and calculation feedback; verify actual tokenization and memory

model.backend_settings: Pin served digest, quantization, chat template, engine, context, sampling defaults and thinking implementation from actual runtime evidence.
model.context_overflow: fail and record; no silent truncation, history deletion or budget change
limitations: financial base-model paper scores do not measure this quantized runtime
basic task inability can obscure workflow differences
no hidden-thinking or memory mechanism identification
model.future_candidate_scope: v4.8 retains observed v4.5 engine settings as candidate; new protocol integration unvalidated.
model.context_check_policy: Require render-only visible-history validation with explicit truncate=false/shift=false; no UTF-8 token heuristic. Actual checks are recorded stage by stage.

renderer_policy.rendered_history: Only declared JSON boundary whitespace removal; internal characters and parsed values unchanged.

model.decoding_revision_applied: Neutral penalties and seed explicitly specified; not claimed as unreported benchmark values.
model.response_contract: per-stage API JSON Schema and identical schema grounded in task prompt

submission.length_format_own_results_requirement: not specified in available overview; do not infer exemption

claims_not_identified: excess convergence relative to a uniquely necessary institutional weight difference

primary_output.definition: First raw final response at workflow stage 4, separately for each R1/R4 case.
primary_output.label_accuracy_role: auxiliary fact extraction diagnostic, not strategy quality

auxiliary_repair.eligibility: C0 completed, structurally valid and exactly one finite weight for each of 11 sectors; abs(sum(w)-1)>1e-6 OR any(w<0 or w>1).
auxiliary_repair.feedback: Actual prior candidate, sum, signed residual, bound violations and prior-candidate weight deltas. No target allocation or semantic verdict.
auxiliary_repair.stop: First arithmetically valid candidate, C2, or first transport/schema/finite-vector failure; no restart.
auxiliary_repair.selection: Retain C0 as primary always; auxiliary terminal submission is last attempted response, never best-of selection.
auxiliary_repair.noneligible: Valid C0, no C0, transport or schema failure, or incomplete/nonfinite sector vector; report reason, do not retry.
auxiliary_repair.meaning: Bounded recovery policy; actual calls may differ across arms. Not equal realized compute or a causal repair-effect experiment.

budget.basis: 3 final candidates including C0 from Precise App I Table12; placement after LIBERA stage4 is local adaptation, not an optimal budget or exact replication.

evaluation.scoring_implementation: Legacy mechanical scorer exists; v4.8 linkage/registry evaluation not integrated or human completed.
evaluation.source_inventory_scope: All 11 sectors in both splits before new outputs; avoid selecting only visibly conflicting labels.
evaluation.denominators: Report scheduled cases, generation-attempt cases, readable responses, complete vectors, valid allocations, and valid pairs separately. Meaningful rationale fragments can be reviewed even if budget invalid; otherwise missing, never inferred.

requires: verbatim raw records and failure accounting
does_not_require: every model answer has budget sum 1
readiness_gate.insufficient_measurement_rule: If C0 allocations do not form valid pairs, weight-contrast outcomes remain unobserved. Report this without a zero-effect claim; do not substitute repaired candidates into primary comparison.
readiness_gate.main_start: Only after versioned implementation checks, complete pilot accounting, independent human source review and frozen protocol. No main execution in this task.

numeric_supplement.role: Appendix-only computed reference; not evidence of documentary strategy preservation or AI success.

2 sources x 2 arms, one market context: data availability, no power claim
qualitative coding scheme: operational adaptation of E2A, not its validated taxonomy
engineering_not_paper_behavioral_constan: Q4_K_M, context65536, batch512, threads2, 900s deadline, 1e-6 sum tolerance
runtime and exact template/digest pins; neutral penalties and sampler defaults; Ollama application of paper seed3407 does not ensure cross-engine equivalence

until-success retries or outcome-driven best-response selection
